statuses.done: Works, and the evidence checks it
statuses.partial: Works with the limits in its note
statuses.gap: Missing or refused; pick it up from the known gaps

rows.item: Separate parts, each with its own sketch and features
Extrude a closed profile to a thickness, thin, or up to a face
Extrude Add: another sketch's extrude joins a part
Extrude Remove from a plane with depth, direction, offset and scope
rows.note: Cuts into earlier placed bodies, blind, through all or up to a face. The extrusion must be square to each target and reach a machinable face.

rows.item: Sketch on the top face, the underside and pocket floors
rows.note: Part Studio sketches keep the current camera, pan and zoom; N looks straight at the sketch plane. An underside sketch is drawn as seen from below, so its X runs the other way.

rows.item: Sketch on faces in the current view and extrude a solid face up to another face
rows.note: Manual camera changes persist through sketches and feature dialogs. Drawing snaps to existing part corners; a solid-face Add requires an explicit merge scope. Direct face extrusion requires an unmodified body face.

rows.item: Datum planes
Face edges show in a sketch drawn on that face, and parts stay tied to them
Inner loops are through-holes unless given a depth
Pocket depths set on the drawing or by clicking the part in 3D, switched off without losing the depth
Rabbets from a face sketch that crosses the part outline
Transform a part: translate, translate by line, rotate, mate connectors
Copies of a part
Linear pattern of parts along a picked edge
Mirror a part across a plane
Part cut: house one part in another with clearance
Select one physical copy as a cut tool
rows.note: Parts-list and viewport picks retain the exact copy tool, including a copy selected before Cut parts opens. A complete tray checks movement, pattern growth and reload. Copy-only targets and consuming a single copy remain unsupported and are explicitly refused.

rows.item: Overlapping parts are reported
Suppress a step
Variables in values
Complete multi-part cabinet edit sequence
rows.note: Core checks cover dimensions, placement, housings and cutting-piece membership. Browser controls exercise all eight edits, cancel, visible physical-part counts, ordered copy identities and reload. Complete interface details, divided-tray workflows and toolpath equivalence remain outside this sequence.

rows.item: Complete divided-tray and fitted-joint source edit sequences
rows.note: Eight cumulative core states per design check authored dependencies, source/copy IDs, occupied material, phase, clearance, collisions and reload. Missing-tool and unconstrained diagnostics stay incomplete. Full UI, boundary meshes and external equivalence remain separate gates.

rows.item: Split a part by a plane
rows.note: Sketch-edge splitting and split joints exist; splitting a solid part into separate boards is not implemented.

rows.item: Circular pattern of parts
rows.note: Circular sketch patterns exist; the part pattern is linear only.

rows.item: Boolean Union and Intersect between existing parts
rows.note: Cut parts subtracts tools from targets; existing bodies cannot be joined or intersected by a Boolean feature.

rows.item: Measure and section view in the Part Studio
rows.note: Sketch measurements exist. Measuring and sectioning the assembled parts are not available.

rows.item: Variable types and ordered definitions
rows.note: Variables are inferred from expressions and apply globally; explicit types, measured values and positional scope are not implemented.

rows.item: Accepted geometry and draft edits persist with the project
Returning to the sketch from Boards keeps its geometry, dimensions, CAM settings and Undo
Save to file and open a saved design
Invalid profiles stay drafts with an explanation while CAM keeps the last accepted geometry
Sketch on an edge face, end-grain holes and angled joints
rows.note: Deferred: only polygons from the top, the underside and pocket floors are modelled (docs/CAD_ROADMAP.md).

rows.item: Lines, by drag or click chain
Corner, center and aligned rectangles
Rectangle corner joins can be removed
Circles, by center or three points
Three-point, tangent and center-point arcs
Points, conics, fit splines and Bezier curves
rows.note: Adding a fit point to a periodic spline is unsupported. Bezier degree is limited to 15. Inserting a fit point may reshape unconstrained geometry while keeping fixed points and driving dimensions.

rows.item: Ellipses
Inscribed and circumscribed polygons
Slots
Construction geometry, kept out of cut profiles
Fillets sharing one radius across selected corners
Chamfers
Trim line, circle and arc spans
rows.note: Rational curves can bound a trim but can't be interval-trimmed themselves.

rows.item: Split an edge at points
Extend line and arc ends
rows.note: An explicitly selected construction boundary can keep a persistent contact. Rational curves can bound an extend but can't be extended.

rows.item: Offset lines, circles, arcs and closed line/arc loops by one signed distance
rows.note: Partial or open multi-edge chains and rational curves are refused.

rows.item: Mirror points, lines, circles and arcs about a straight axis as linked copies
rows.note: Mirror rejects conics, fit splines and Bezier curves.

rows.item: Transform sketch geometry: translate, rotate, scale
Linear and circular sketch patterns
Use points from another part's corners
rows.note: Corner points only; projecting whole edges is not there yet.

rows.item: Driving dimensions: length, distance, angle, diameter, radius, arc gaps
Dimension labels follow geometry through drags, Undo/Redo and reload
Value fields take units, fractions and arithmetic, and never show a doubled unit
Coincident, horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular, equal, tangent and midpoint constraints
Symmetric and concentric constraints
Spline endpoint handles can be selected and constrained on their own
Normal, Pierce and Equal curvature constraints
rows.note: Their shortcuts say the constraint isn't available yet.

rows.item: Through-cut profiles from exact polygons
Pockets, recesses and rabbets
Through-hole middles cleared, left for the vacuum or fixed by hand
V-bit carving
Tabs
Board nesting and auto-fill from stock
Hold suggestions: clamps and screws
Side B program for underside cuts
rows.note: Cuts from the two faces that would meet are refused. No side B program has been cut on the machine yet.

rows.item: G-code checked for the controller
Machining revision and physical-sheet checks after geometry changes
3D material removal preview
Controller connection, status reports and jogging
Run, pause and resume a job
Alarms explained
Camera calibration
Machine plane and bounds for the camera overlay
A side B program cut on the machine
rows.note: Not tried on a real machine yet.
